title: The climate case for AI has not been made

claims.claim: In 2024, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman declared that AI would fix the climate.

evidence.quote: In 2024, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman declared that AI would unleash “astounding triumphs,” including “fixing the climate.”

claims.claim: Google sustainability leaders wrote in a 2023 op-ed that AI could reduce global emissions 5% to 10% by 2030.

evidence.quote: The year before, in a 2023 op-ed, the head of sustainability at Google and her coauthor wrote that AI could reduce global emissions 5% to 10% by 2030.

claims.claim: A peer-reviewed study published last year estimated that AI could help cut global emissions by the equivalent of 3.2 to 5.4 billion tons of carbon dioxide annually by 2035.

evidence.quote: A peer-reviewed study published last year, led by researchers at the London School of Economics’ Grantham Research Institute and the firm Systemiq, estimated that AI could help cut global emissions by the equivalent of 3.2 to 5.4 billion tons of carbon dioxide annually by 2035—roughly on par with the US’s annual energy-related emissions on the high end, even after subtracting AI’s own energy footprint.

A peer-reviewed study published last year, led by researchers at the London School of Economics’ Grantham Research Institute and the firm Systemiq, estimated that AI could help cut global emissions by the equivalent of 3.2 to 5.4 billion tons of carbon dioxide annually by 2035

claims.claim: A partnership between the UK’s National Grid ESO and Open Climate Fix halved the grid operator’s solar-forecast error.

evidence.quote: A partnership between the UK’s National Grid ESO and Open Climate Fix halved the grid operator’s solar-forecast error

claims.claim: Venture capital flowing into cultivated meat fell from a $989 million peak in 2021 to around $83 million last year.

evidence.quote: Most notably, venture capital flowing into cultivated meat fell from a $989 million peak in 2021 to around $83 million last year.

claims.claim: CATL controls roughly 40% of the global market for electric-vehicle batteries.

evidence.quote: CATL—which controls roughly 40% of the global market for electric-vehicle batteries—launched an AI system trained on more than 100,000 battery design cases and 600 terabytes of test data.

claims.claim: CATL launched an AI system trained on more than 100,000 battery design cases and 600 terabytes of test data.

evidence.quote: CATL—which controls roughly 40% of the global market for electric-vehicle batteries—launched an AI system trained on more than 100,000 battery design cases and 600 terabytes of test data.

claims.claim: Emissions associated with global data centers could exceed 300 million tons annually in 2035 according to the IEA’s base forecast.

evidence.quote: Emissions associated with global data centers (which may handle AI as well as non-AI computing tasks) could exceed 300 million tons annually in 2035, according to the IEA’s base forecast.
